title: 世界球花 v1 — Telemetry Dashboard
description_html: Internal dashboard. Auth handled by nginx in production. Pre-baked queries below cover the Daily Pulse and Weekly Funnel from 02-dashboards.md.

01_dau.title: DAU (last 30 days)
01_dau.description: Distinct active user_id per day. Target ≥ 10/day at 7d, ≥ 30/day at 30d.
01_dau.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS dau FROM telemetry_event WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND event_name IN ('research.dashboard_view','research.answer_attempt','research.dimension_attempt') AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY day DESC

02_register_daily.title: New registrations per day
02_register_daily.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='auth.register_success' AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY day DESC

03_paid_daily.title: New paid users per day
03_paid_daily.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS new_paid FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='billing.redeem_success' AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY day DESC

04_questions_daily.title: Questions per day (free vs chip)
04_questions_daily.description: Free-form vs 6-dim chip questions. Target ≥ 30/day at 30d.
04_questions_daily.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='research.answer_attempt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_q, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='research.dimension_attempt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chip_q FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name IN ('research.answer_attempt','research.dimension_attempt') AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY day DESC

05_error_rate_hourly.title: 5xx error rate (last 7 days, hourly)
05_error_rate_hourly.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', ts) AS hour, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='system.error_5xx' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='system.error_5xx' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS error_pct FROM telemetry_event WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 days') GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00', ts) ORDER BY hour DESC

06_dashboard_p95.title: Dashboard P95 latency (NFR-1, target < 5000ms)
06_dashboard_p95.description: Approx P95 per day. NFR-1 P95 < 5s for paid users.
06_dashboard_p95.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT date(ts) AS day, duration_ms FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='research.dashboard_completed' AND status='ok' AND ts >= datetime('now','-7 days')) SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(duration_ms) AS min_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_ms FROM d GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

07_pipeline_p95.title: Pipeline P95 latency (NFR-2, target < 30000ms)
07_pipeline_p95.description: Approx P95 per day for pipeline.job_completed.
07_pipeline_p95.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT date(ts) AS day, duration_ms FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='pipeline.job_completed' AND ts >= datetime('now','-7 days')) SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(duration_ms) AS min_ms, MAX(duration_ms) AS max_ms FROM d GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC

08_info_insufficient_rate.title: info_insufficient trigger rate
08_info_insufficient_rate.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, COUNT(*) AS dashboard_views, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.lean')='info_insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS info_insufficient, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.lean')='info_insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS pct FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='research.dashboard_view' AND ts >= datetime('now','-7 days') GROUP BY date(ts) ORDER BY day DESC

09_funnel_weekly.title: Funnel — last 7 days
09_funnel_weekly.description: Invite visit → register → unlock view → redeem attempt → success. Target invite→paid ≥ 15% (7d).
09_funnel_weekly.sql: WITH this_week AS (SELECT user_id, event_name FROM telemetry_event WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 days') AND event_name IN ('auth.invite_visit','auth.register_success','billing.unlock_view','billing.redeem_attempt','billing.redeem_success')) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='auth.invite_visit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step1_visit, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='auth.register_success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step2_register, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='billing.unlock_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step3_unlock_view, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='billing.redeem_attempt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step4_redeem_attempt, SUM(CASE WHEN event_name='billing.redeem_success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS step5_redeem_success FROM this_week

10_d1_retention.title: D1 retention by cohort
10_d1_retention.description: Did user return the day after registration? Target ≥ 40% (7d), ≥ 50% (30d).
10_d1_retention.sql: WITH cohort AS (SELECT user_id, date(ts) AS reg_date FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='auth.register_success' AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days')) SELECT c.reg_date, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telemetry_event t WHERE t.user_id=c.user_id AND date(t.ts)=date(c.reg_date,'+1 day')) THEN c.user_id END) AS d1_returned, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telemetry_event t WHERE t.user_id=c.user_id AND date(t.ts)=date(c.reg_date,'+1 day')) THEN c.user_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id), 0), 1) AS d1_pct FROM cohort c GROUP BY c.reg_date ORDER BY c.reg_date DESC

11_adapter_health.title: Adapter success rate (last 7 days)
11_adapter_health.description: ALERT-12 fires if any adapter ok_pct < 30% for 24h.
11_adapter_health.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.adapter') AS adapter, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed, SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='skipped' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.status')='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 1) AS ok_pct FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='pipeline.adapter_called' AND ts >= datetime('now','-7 days') GROUP BY json_extract(payload_json,'$.adapter') ORDER BY ok_pct ASC

12_llm_usage.title: LLM token usage (last 30 days)
12_llm_usage.description: Multiply by DeepSeek pricing for monthly cost. Target < ¥500/month.
12_llm_usage.sql: SELECT date(ts) AS day, json_extract(payload_json,'$.purpose') AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CAST(json_extract(payload_json,'$.prompt_tokens') AS INTEGER)) AS prompt_tok, SUM(CAST(json_extract(payload_json,'$.completion_tokens') AS INTEGER)) AS completion_tok FROM telemetry_event WHERE event_name='llm.call_completed' AND status='ok' AND ts >= datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(ts), json_extract(payload_json,'$.purpose') ORDER BY day DESC, purpose

13_recent_alerts.title: Recently fired alerts (last 7 days)
13_recent_alerts.description: Audit trail of ALERT-* with delivery status.
13_recent_alerts.sql: SELECT rule_id, severity, fired_at, delivery_status, sent_to, payload_json FROM alert_fired WHERE fired_at >= datetime('now','-7 days') ORDER BY fired_at DESC

14_event_volume.title: Event volume by name (last 7 days)
14_event_volume.description: Sanity check that all expected event names are showing up.
14_event_volume.sql: SELECT event_name, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(ts) AS first_ts, MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM telemetry_event WHERE ts >= datetime('now','-7 days') GROUP BY event_name ORDER BY n DESC
